purpose: Prospective numerical and paired-development criteria for improving production pressure physics on an already observed plant event. Candidate-specific equations and parameters require a separate frozen configuration before execution.

baseline.policy: Preserve exact released bytes, including historical source hashes, metadata and conclusions. Never restamp or rewrite the baseline as a new run.

reference.additionalDiagnostic: Measured indicated pressurizer level versus modeled liquid-volume fraction; disclose the unresolved instrument transfer function, do not call it a validated volume measurement.
reference.initialPointPolicy: Initialize from published Table 2 values. Interpolated t=0 is shown only as initialization bias and excluded from scored error metrics. Do not shift the measured time axis or infer missing controls from held-out responses.

requiredPairedCases.purpose: Current-code equilibrium ablation with the same initial conditions, geometry, capacities and boundary forcing as the released v0.10 case.
New production pressure formulation with the same boundary forcing and disclosed initialization; any additional model assumptions must be frozen separately before candidate scoring.

numericalRequirements: Both formulations must complete nominal and refined runs inside their declared property and state domains.

Independently reconstruct external mass/energy integrals from held inputs and primitive native endpoint quantities. Include every new stored fluid, gas, wall or interface energy inventory in the conservation boundary.
Native integrated ledgers and independent quadrature must satisfy the frozen inventory tolerances; algebraic residuals alone are insufficient.
Preserve all acquired comparison times and all native communication boundaries; never extrapolate an incomplete run.
The current equilibrium ablation must reproduce the immutable released baseline within the stated numerical reproduction tolerances. Record actual differences rather than replacing baseline traces.
Any additional mesh or constitutive sensitivities must be declared in the candidate configuration before scoring and retained regardless of success.
additionalPressureDiagnostics: change from initial to acquired-sample peak

pairedImprovementCriteria.communicationAllowance: For the primary-pressure RMSE and maximum-absolute-error comparisons, use the sum of the candidate and reference maximum pointwise nominal/refined pressure differences at t=0 and acquired times. For change-from-initial RMSE, use twice that sum, because both initial and subsequent values enter the metric. Use the immutable report's recorded refinement difference when the reference is v0.10. This is a communication-step diagnostic allowance, not a physical uncertainty bound.
pairedImprovementCriteria.primaryRule: Each required primary metric must decrease by more than its corresponding communication allowance versus both references.
pairedImprovementCriteria.nonDegradationRule: For every other held-out channel, candidate RMSE and maximum absolute error must not exceed either reference by more than the sum of candidate and reference maximum nominal/refined pointwise differences for that channel. Report all signed deltas even when this guard passes.
pairedImprovementCriteria.meaning: Passing these criteria supports only a development-event improvement with no hidden material degradation in the other scored channels. It is not independent predictive validation or an instrument-based acceptance band.

controlAndCalibrationPolicy: The initial paired comparison preserves v0.10 measured heat/steam/feedwater forcing and zero assumptions for unquantified heater/charging/letdown controls. Do not fit geometry, transfer parameters or actuator histories to post-initialization pressure or temperature while calling the result independently validated. Any later response-informed model selection or calibration must be separately labeled development, with all attempted configurations retained.
publicationPolicy: Always retain executed discrepancies, failed cases and adverse channel changes. A failed numerical or paired-improvement criterion cannot be relabeled as passing or used to promote a candidate as improved production accuracy. An experimental result may be documented with its failed status; default model promotion requires the paired guards plus existing cold-start, continuous-startup and property/conservation regressions.
independentValidationStatus: No new independent plant event is introduced. Existing PACTEL cases are additional previously observed component evidence and must retain their own provenance, uncertainty qualifications and development history.
